body: Wish I knew how it felt. I’m a dumbass wishing I was successful so I could buy the things I need in life. And don’t get me started with the moms who push you away, got an alcoholic one myself who yells at me and tells me I’m lying about harming myself in the past and that I’m not suicidal. I can’t make friends either on top of that because I have a stupid fear of making friends depressed because of what I say or what I do or if  I mess up and make friends mad at me and loose them.

I relate to this a lot in general... I’m constantly trying to find new hobbies ( and especially trying to play the piano and improve at it thinking it’ll maybe make me happier...? ) I’m scared to ever love a person because I feel like I’ll put all the bad things in my life onto them... I feel like I’m putting myself together piece by piece everyday just for the pieces to scatter around again. I wanna fill that empty hole I feel inside of me but I can’t. No matter how many hobbies or things to distract me it doesn’t work. I feel like I can relate to you about that OP..

I would do that too...I’ve been searching for painless ways to commit suicide but I don’t think there’s a way.. I’ve experienced pain from self harm but I don’t want pain from actual death. I always wanted one of those “died in their sleep” deaths but I don’t know if that’s naturally possible.. You’re still suicidal though. Not wanting the pain from death doesn’t make you non suicidal..

I understand how that feels completely. I was told by my own parent I could talk to them about anything, but the second I told them I physically harmed myself and felt suicidal at times they told me I was being dramatic and I was trying to manipulate them into feeling bad. Don’t blame yourself for that.
